class.name: AudioEffectConvolution
class.brief_description: Mariner: convolution with a measured impulse response.
class.description: Mariner: uniformly partitioned overlap-save FFT convolution (block 256 frames; the wet signal lags by one block). The impulse response is set with [method set_impulse] as float samples and resampled linearly to the mix rate (up to 12 seconds).

method.name: get_impulse_left
method.description: Left (or only) channel of the impulse response as given.

method.name: get_impulse_rate
method.description: Sample rate of the impulse response as given.

method.name: get_impulse_right
method.description: Right channel of the impulse response as given (empty: the left one is used for both).

method.name: get_partition_count
method.description: Number of 256-frame partitions of the prepared impulse response.

method.name: set_impulse
method.description: Sets the impulse response: samples of the left channel, of the right one (may be empty) and their sample rate. The spectra are prepared on the calling thread.

members.member: Level of the input passed through.
